name: Viggle
summary: Spatial AI platform for animating characters with motion, used for memes, games and an API.
description: Viggle animates characters by transferring motion onto them in any scene. Products include Meme Maker for swapping characters into videos, PINOC for capturing motion and exporting rigged 3D animation in FBX or GLB, games and a developer API. The Free plan allows five videos per day; paid Viggle plans start at $7.99 per month, and the API is pay-as-you-go at $0.01 per credit.

howToUse.title: Open Viggle
howToUse.description: Open Viggle. The Free plan allows five videos a day. Paid plans start at $7.99 a month.

howToUse.title: Animate with Meme Maker
howToUse.description: In Meme Maker, Viggle animates characters by swapping them into videos and transferring the motion of that scene onto them.

howToUse.title: Capture motion in PINOC
howToUse.description: Use PINOC for capturing a performance, then exporting the rigged 3D animation as FBX or as GLB.

howToUse.title: Play a game or call the API
howToUse.description: Remix games with your character, or call the developer API. It bills pay-as-you-go at $0.01 for each credit.
